fr-2026-21512.title: Notification to Members/Shareholders
fr-2026-21512.sourceVersion: Federal Register document 2026-21512, proposed rule, published October 21, 2026
fr-2026-21512.source: the agency's official summary in the Federal Register
fr-2026-21512.passage: The NCUA Board (Board) solicits public comment on a proposal to streamline the methods a federally insured credit union (FICU) may use to provide its members with notice of share insurance coverage. The current regulation is overly prescriptive, mandating that a FICU make available hard copies of certain prescribed materials. While a FICU would still be required to provide notice to members, the proposed rule would defer to the FICU on the method used for such notification. Among other methods, a FICU may elect to provide members with a link to updated online resources that will be maintained on the NCUA website. The Board believes the proposed rule will provide greater flexibility, reduce compliance costs for both NCUA and FICUs, and ensure that members are provided with up-to-date information regarding share insurance coverage.
fr-2026-21512.scopeReviewed: The agency's summary only. The full notice wasn't reviewed.

fr-2026-21305.title: Safety Zone; FRL Inaugural Invitational eFoil Exhibition Race, Miami Marine Stadium Basin, Miami, FL
fr-2026-21305.sourceVersion: Federal Register document 2026-21305, notice of proposed rulemaking, published October 19, 2026
fr-2026-21305.source: the agency's official summary in the Federal Register
fr-2026-21305.passage: The Coast Guard is proposing to establish a temporary safety zone for certain navigable waters in the Miami Marine Stadium Basin in connection with the FRL Inaugural Invitational eFoil Exhibition Race. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with eFoil race operations. This proposed rulemaking would prohibit persons and vessels from being in the safety zone unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Miami. We invite your comments on this proposed rulemaking.
fr-2026-21305.scopeReviewed: The agency's summary only. The full notice, which would give the zone's exact boundaries and times, wasn't reviewed.

quotes: temporary safety zone for certain navigable waters in the Miami Marine Stadium Basin

quotes: protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with eFoil race operations

claims.text: People and vessels could not be in the zone unless the Captain of the Port, Sector Miami, specifically allows it. That exception matters: entry isn't banned outright, it requires permission.
quotes: unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Miami

quotes: We invite your comments on this proposed rulemaking.
